Training

How you can train

From the gym’s own post on Google and from what members write in their reviews.

Personal training

One to one, semi-private or in a small group. The gym promises proper technique and personal attention, with a flexible timetable.

Strength and conditioning

Strength and conditioning, functional training and circuit training, for all fitness levels. Members write that every session is different.

Boxing

Boxing for all levels, also as private classes. Boxing training comes up in 9 Google reviews.
